text: 44-year-old female. The patient presents to the emergency department with confusion that started this morning. The patient's husband reports that she initially complained of abdominal pain, diarrhea, and fatigue after eating and has vomited 3 times. The patient has progressively become more confused throughout the day. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) secondary to missed insulin post-sleeve gastrectomy.

I am concerned about the confusion and vomiting in a diabetic patient with a recent gastric sleeve; have you been taking your insulin or diabetes medication recently? I also need to know if there have been any episodes of deep rapid breathing or a fruity odor on her breath.
